gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-rethink-sans: Bellota Text takes the lead with open, unshaded letterforms that look confident and a bit unusual on the page. And Rethink Sans follows with generous openings and strokes of one weight, friendly and modern where the heading is bold.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-roboto-flex:
Roboto Flex has a wide slot between the two ends of its c.

Bellota Text is the louder voice, made for display with open, unshaded curves, while Roboto Flex stays friendly and modern underneath.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-rosario: Commanding and a little unusual, Bellota Text runs a single stroke width through its whole alphabet, with no calligraphic shading. Rosario, by contrast, is contemporary and approachable.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ruluko: Bellota Text gives headings a commanding, distinctive look, with open c, e and s shapes and no calligraphic shading. But Ruluko takes over below with broad open counters, so a longer passage feels clean and approachable.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-sansation: Distinctive from the first glance, Bellota Text looks cut from strips of equal width, with open c, e and s shapes. Sansation stays approachable.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-sarabun: Sarabun has a wide channel into every bowl, which makes it clean and approachable underneath Bellota Text. Sarabun would be comfortable at a modest size, while the commanding, open-shaped Bellota Text can go bigger.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-sarala: Approachable and contemporary, Sarala draws distinct gaps in c, e and s with a thickness like neon glass tubing. And Bellota Text above it adds a commanding display voice with open shapes and no calligraphic shading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Sawarabi Gothic leaves open jaws on every curved stroke, which gives it a contemporary, neutral feel under the commanding Bellota Text heading. A longer page reads smoothly.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-shanti: No modulation between stems and connecting strokes marks Bellota Text, which also has open c, e and s shapes and a commanding presence. Shanti is modern and professional.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-shippori-antique: Contemporary and modern, Shippori Antique has a monoweight skeleton and open bowls like a ladle tipped toward you, beneath the commanding Bellota Text. Its strength is distinctive character.
